highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.0 modernizes the binding and moves to the Skia m116 renderer.
highlights_body: This preview adds new APIs and platform support while removing obsolete v2 surface area. Review the breaking changes before migrating.

breaking.title: Obsolete v2 APIs were removed
breaking.body: Deprecated graphics, text, bitmap, codec, and OpenGL APIs are no longer available. Replace each call with the successor named in the API diff before upgrading.

breaking.title: Legacy Index8 bitmap support was removed
breaking.body: Color-table and Index8 bitmap and codec overloads are gone. Use supported color types and the current pixel installation and decoding overloads.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled rendering engine and its native dependencies for the 3.0 line.
Adds SKBlender, picture recording options, raw image shaders, pixel spans, and span-based geometry and color-filter overloads.

bullets.lead: Expanded desktop, Apple, and WinUI support
bullets.detail: Adds accelerated WinUI views and WPF SKGLElement support, aligns Metal targets, and includes ANGLE runtime assets.
Fixes MAUI and Uno canvas lifetime issues, Apple Metal snapshots, kerning, and cloned paint disposal.
